While pricing may be a significant factor in the evaluation of offers, the final award decision will be based on a combination of price, delivery, and performance.

Offers must be submitted on a hard copy of the SF 1449 Request for Quote (RFQ), scanned, and uploaded through DIBBS (PREFERRED METHOD) or emailed to: JENNIFER.CUMMINS@DLA.MIL. A single email cannot exceed 15 MB. Offers greater than 15 MB must be divided into multiple emails.

For additional guidance, refer to https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/refs/help/Solicitations/DIBBS-Upload-Offer-User-Help.pdf

All offers shall be in the English language and in US dollars.  All interested suppliers may submit an offer. All interested suppliers may submit an offer. One or more of the items under this acquisition may be subject to Trade Agreements.

Based on market research this item is commercial of-a-type; therefore, the Government is using the policies contained in FAR Part 13.5 in its solicitation for this item.

The drawings, specifications, and relevant technical data are posted in cFolders once the solicitation is published. 

The solicitation will be available on DLA’s Internet Bid Board Site (DIBBS) on or about: 3/6/2026.
